explanation: This is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and 0 at all steps before about trial 70. Late in the episode (trial 70 and later) it rises at D1 after one or more unrewarded trials, mostly when the agent is about to switch to a1: about 8-10 after two or more misses in a row (or the trial right after a miss on a2), about 3-5 after a single miss, and near 0 at D1 after a rewarded streak.
